expectations.text: Identifies the NISG 2026, which entered into force October 1, 2026, replacing the NISG 2018
expectations.evidence: "Austria's NISG 2026 (BGBl. I Nr. 94/2025...) entered into force on 1 October 2026 and repealed the NISG 2018"

expectations.text: States the registration deadline: December 31, 2026 (within three months of entry into force)
expectations.evidence: "Register by 31 December 2026 with the BCS. This is the immediate deadline"

expectations.text: Names the competent authority: the new Bundesamt fuer Cybersicherheit (BCS) under the Interior Ministry
expectations.evidence: "The competent authority is the new Bundesamt fuer Cybersicherheit (BCS), under the Interior Ministry"

expectations.text: Gives the penalty frame: up to EUR 10M or 2 percent of worldwide turnover for essential entities, EUR 7M or 1.4 percent for important entities
expectations.evidence: "Penalties are up to EUR 7M or 1.4 percent of worldwide annual turnover... For an essential entity the figures are EUR 10M or 2 percent."

expectations.text: Applies scope correctly: medium and large entities (50 or more employees or over EUR 10M turnover) across 18 sectors, so a 120-employee manufacturer is likely in scope, with a risk-management self-declaration due within a further 12 months
expectations.evidence: "It covers 18 sectors and applies to medium and large entities (50 or more employees, or over EUR 10M turnover)"; concludes likely Important Entity and "Self-declare your risk-management measures within a further 12 months"
